decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the newly specified direct-on-NFT display surface; the remaining referral-code identity rules are unchanged.
The same-message MODIFY already captures transfer of active prize tickets to the resale buyer, while the other transferred state remains unchanged.
The same-message MODIFY already captures ticket-weighted eligibility, including active tickets acquired through resale; the VRF method remains unchanged.
The existing same-message MODIFY captures the general $5 commission allocation and the founder share being net of applicable fiat fees; no additional revenue attribute necessarily changes.
The same source message already introduces the no-referral $5 commission allocation to a random existing NFT holder.
The FAQ reiterates that the mint-number referral code appears in NFT metadata but does not change the existing metadata source or counter and badge requirements.
The source reiterates the existing immediate automatic $5 wallet commission for a successful code-used mint without changing its trigger, recipient, amount, or payout behavior.
Transak and its supported cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay methods were already established before this source Event and are only restated.
The FAQ restates the existing five $500 prizes, approximate 500-sale interval, and inclusion of mint and secondary sales without changing the Small Block mechanism.
The source continues to describe an unlimited-mint NFT ebook and does not change the collection model.
The FAQ restates the existing five $10,000 prizes at an approximate 50,000-sale interval with mint and secondary sales counted; no Big Block state changes.
The source repeats the already documented referral milestones and on-chain badge recording; changes to explanatory badge utility copy do not alter badge award accuracy.
